info.title: Agenda API
info.description:
REST API for Agenda: calendars, events, tasks and reminders.

Errors always use the `ErrorResponse` shape. Clients should branch on `code`, not on `message`.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app

version.description: Short commit hash of the deployed build, or "dev"

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, used by clients for i18n

message.description: Human-readable English description, for logs and debugging

requestId.description: Also returned in the X-Request-Id header

timeZone.description: IANA zone the demo day is laid out in. Defaults to UTC

password.description: Plain-text password, accepted only in register/login requests

timeZone.description: IANA zone the account starts in, usually the browser zone. Defaults to UTC

password.description: Plain-text password, accepted only in register/login requests

get.description: Answers as soon as the process is running and never touches the database. Used by the hosting health check and by the web app to wake the service after it has been idle. Not rate limited.
Checks that the database answers within two seconds. Not rate limited.
